propositions: Reconciler Mutation uses generic Mapping[str, Any] payload instead of a typed discriminated union by (direction, action), requiring legacy _mutation_to_batch_dict() conversion and polymorphic applier.apply() dispatch.
PydanticAIRunner.run() has fragmented ownership across ProviderSession, model_classes, structured_run, agent_call, runner_support, and capability modules without clear lifecycle/fault boundaries.

OperationSnapshot is defined as authoritative for reconciler runtime bindings but CLI/shared commands still call emit_shadow_snapshot() and LLM operations independently resolve LLMConfig.from_env(), creating ambient configuration re-reading during operation execution.
reconcile.py and reconcile_helpers.py exceed or approach the 800-LOC module-size ceiling, blocking refactoring needed to implement typed payloads and unified routes.
Producer code retains a 24-value outbound-update bundle without cohesive typed inputs, requiring extraction using Brant/RP-03 types.
